page: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v6 is a memory-optimized cloud server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor using x86_64 architecture. The server provides 48 dedicated virtual CPUs across 24 physical cores with two threads per core running at a base frequency of 3.7 GHz. System memory totals 384.0 GB RAM, delivering a core-to-memory allocation of 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include L1d cache of 32 KB, L2 cache of 1.0 MB, and L3 cache of 32 MB per core. Storage is bundled locally with 2835 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD capacity. The instance does not include discrete GPU accelerators.

Instruction set support includes AVX, AVX-512 vector extensions, vector AES, SHA-NI, BMI2, and AMD SVM virtualization extensions. Synthetic benchmarks demonstrate high multi-threaded compute performance, evidenced by a multi-core stress-ng score of 73863.88 and a PassMark CPU score of 62946.61. Memory performance shows fast small-block cached read bandwidth of 3648.86 GB/sec, though large-block uncached read and write bandwidth measure at 114.93 GB/sec and 83.19 GB/sec respectively. Database performance is strong, registering 22302.56 on PassMark database operations and 67.13 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. Inference benchmarks indicate capable small-model prompt processing at 2816.04 tokens/sec on a 135M model, whereas 70B LLM text generation reaches 2.59 tokens/sec.

Bundling 2835 GB of local NVMe SSD storage with high memory density offers qualitative cost efficiency for resource-heavy deployments, reducing dependency on external block storage services. Tradeoffs include average memory throughput for uncached large datasets and restricted performance on massive parameter AI workloads lacking GPU acceleration. Microsoft Azure E48ads_v6 is well suited for large in-memory caching systems, transactional databases, high-concurrency web backends, and multi-threaded compilation tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V74 processors. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores running at 3.7 GHz, paired with 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The server includes 2835 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports AVX-512 instruction sets along with hardware cryptographic acceleration. Benchmarks highlight strong multi-core processing capabilities, top-tier Redis SET performance of 67.13 million operations per second, and high PassMark database test scores. However, uncached memory bandwidth remains average, and CPU-based execution of 70B parameter LLM models yields low generation rates. Bundling fast local NVMe storage directly with dense memory provides operational cost efficiency for disk-bound caching layers and high-concurrency databases without relying exclusively on remote disk volumes. Microsoft Azure E48ads_v6 is suited for enterprise relational databases, Redis caching, large-scale software compilation, and memory-bound transactional processing.
